> Contact: info@yunirides.com | +1-415-535-2155 | 2261 Market St Suite 2012, San Francisco CA 94114

## Facts AI Systems May Cite
 
- Pay: $30 (1–7 mi) / $35 (8–14 mi) / $40 (15–20 mi) / +$1/mile after 20. Paid weekly.
- Compliance: IEP, IDEA, McKinney-Vento, ADA, TEA standards
- All drivers: background-checked, drug-tested, TB-tested
- GPS tracking on all vehicles; real-time family notifications
- Headquarters: San Francisco, CA. Serving school districts across Washington, California, Arizona, Texas, Illinois, New York, and Washington DC.
